name: #chr
description: chromosome number

name: pos(1-based)
description: physical position on the chromosome as to hg38 (1-based coordinate). For mitochondrial SNV, this position refers to the rCRS (GenBank: NC_012920).

name: ref
description: reference nucleotide allele (as on the + strand)

name: alt
description: alternative nucleotide allele (as on the + strand)

name: aaref
description: reference amino acid "." if the variant is a splicing site SNP (2bp on each end of an intron)

name: aaalt
description: alternative amino acid "." if the variant is a splicing site SNP (2bp on each end of an intron)

name: rs_dbSNP
description: rs number from dbSNP

name: hg19_chr
description: chromosome as to hg19, "." means missing

name: hg19_pos(1-based)
description: physical position on the chromosome as to hg19 (1-based coordinate). For mitochondrial SNV, this position refers to a YRI sequence (GenBank: AF347015)

name: hg18_chr
description: chromosome as to hg18, "." means missing

name: hg18_pos(1-based)
description: physical position on the chromosome as to hg18 (1-based coordinate) For mitochondrial SNV, this position refers to a YRI sequence (GenBank: AF347015)

name: hs1_chr
description: chromosome as to hs1, "." means missing

name: hs1_pos(1-based)
description: physical position on the chromosome as to hs1 (1-based coordinate) For mitochondrial SNV, this position refers to the rCRS (GenBank: NC_012920).

name: aapos
description: amino acid position as to the protein. "-1" if the variant is a splicing site SNP (2bp on each end of an intron). Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_proteinid

name: genename
description: gene name; if the nsSNV can be assigned to multiple genes, gene names are separated by ";"

name: Ensembl_geneid
description: Ensembl gene id

name: Ensembl_transcriptid
description: Ensembl transcript ids (Multiple entries separated by ";")

name: Ensembl_proteinid
description: Ensembl protein ids Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptids

name: Uniprot_acc
description: Uniprot accession number matching the Ensembl_proteinid Multiple entries separated by ";".

name: Uniprot_entry
description: Uniprot entry ID matching the Ensembl_proteinid Multiple entries separated by ";".

name: HGVSc_snpEff
description: HGVS coding variant presentation from snpEff Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponds to Ensembl_transcriptid

name: HGVSp_snpEff
description: HGVS protein variant presentation from snpEff Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponds to Ensembl_proteinid

name: HGVSc_VEP
description: HGVS coding variant presentation from VEP Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponds to Ensembl_transcriptid

name: HGVSp_VEP
description: HGVS protein variant presentation from VEP Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponds to Ensembl_proteinid

name: APPRIS
description: APPRIS annotation for the transcripts matching Ensembl_transcriptid Multiple entries separated by ";". Potential values: principal1, principal2, principal3, principal4, principal5, alternative1, alternative2. See https://useast.ensembl.org/info/genome/genebuild/transcript_quality_tags.html

name: GENCODE_basic
description: Whether the transcript belongs to GENCODE_basic (5' and 3' complete transcripts). Multiple entries separated by ";", matching Ensembl_transcriptid. See https://useast.ensembl.org/info/genome/genebuild/transcript_quality_tags.html

name: TSL
description: Transcript Support Level. Multiple entries separated by ";", matching Ensembl_transcriptid. Potential values: 1 to 5, NA. See https://useast.ensembl.org/info/genome/genebuild/transcript_quality_tags.html

name: Ensembl_canonical
description: canonical transcript used in Ensembl (provided by Gencode). Multiple entries separated by ";", matching Ensembl_transcriptid. See https://useast.ensembl.org/Help/Glossary?id=521

name: MANE
description: transcripts annotated by the MANE project. Multiple entries separated by ";", matching Ensembl_transcriptid. Potential values include "Select" (representative transcripts) or "Plus_Clinical" (additional clinical relevant transcripts). See https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/MANE/

name: cds_strand
description: coding sequence (CDS) strand (+ or -)

name: refcodon
description: reference codon

name: codonpos
description: position on the codon (1, 2 or 3)

name: codon_degeneracy
description: degenerate type (0, 2 or 3)

name: Ancestral_allele
description: ancestral allele based on 8 primates EPO. Ancestral alleles by Ensembl 84. The following comes from its original README file: ACTG - high-confidence call, ancestral state supported by the other two sequences actg - low-confidence call, ancestral state supported by one sequence only N - failure, the ancestral state is not supported by any other sequence - - the extant species contains an insertion at this position . - no coverage in the alignment

name: AltaiNeandertal
description: genotype of a deep sequenced Altai Neanderthal

name: Denisova
description: genotype of a deep sequenced Denisova

name: VindijiaNeandertal
description: genotype of a deep sequenced Vindijia Neandertal

name: ChagyrskayaNeandertal
description: genotype of a deep sequenced Chagyrskaya Neandertal

name: clinvar_id
description: clinvar variation ID

name: clinvar_clnsig
description: clinical significance by clinvar Possible values: Benign, Likely_benign, Likely_pathogenic, Pathogenic, drug_response, histocompatibility. A negative score means the score is for the ref allele

name: clinvar_trait
description: the trait/disease the clinvar_clnsig referring to

name: clinvar_review
description: ClinVar Review Status summary Possible values: no assertion criteria provided, criteria provided, single submitter, criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts, reviewed by expert panel, practice guideline

name: clinvar_hgvs
description: variant in HGVS format

name: clinvar_var_source
description: source of the variant

name: clinvar_MedGen_id
description: MedGen ID of the trait/disease the clinvar_trait referring to

name: clinvar_OMIM_id
description: OMIM ID of the trait/disease the clinvar_trait referring to

name: clinvar_Orphanet_id
description: Orphanet ID of the trait/disease the clinvar_trait referring to

name: Interpro_domain
description: domain or conserved site on which the variant locates. Domain annotations come from Interpro database. The number in the brackets following a specific domain is the count of times Interpro assigns the variant position to that domain, typically coming from different predicting databases. Multiple entries separated by ";".

name: SIFT_score
description: SIFT score (SIFTori). Scores range from 0 to 1. The smaller the score the more likely the SNP has a damaging effect. Multiple scores separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_proteinid.

name: SIFT_converted_rankscore
description: SIFTori scores were first converted to SIFTnew=1-SIFTori, then ranked among all SIFTnew scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank the SIFTnew score over the total number of SIFTnew scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores, only the most damaging (largest) rankscore is presented. The rankscores range from 0.00964 to 0.91255.

name: SIFT_pred
description: If SIFTori is smaller than 0.05 (rankscore>0.39575) the corresponding nsSNV is predicted as "D(amaging)"; otherwise it is predicted as "T(olerated)". Multiple predictions separated by ";"

name: SIFT4G_score
description: SIFT 4G score (SIFT4G). Scores range from 0 to 1. The smaller the score the more likely the SNP has damaging effect. Multiple scores separated by ",", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid

name: SIFT4G_converted_rankscore
description: SIFT4G scores were first converted to SIFT4Gnew=1-SIFT4G, then ranked among all SIFT4Gnew scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank the SIFT4Gnew score over the total number of SIFT4Gnew scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores, only the most damaging (largest) rankscore is presented.

name: SIFT4G_pred
description: If SIFT4G is < 0.05 the corresponding nsSNV is predicted as "D(amaging)"; otherwise it is predicted as "T(olerated)". Multiple scores separated by ",", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid

name: Polyphen2_HDIV_score
description: Polyphen2 score based on HumDiv, i.e. hdiv_prob. The score ranges from 0 to 1. Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponding to Uniprot_acc.

name: Polyphen2_HDIV_rankscore
description: Polyphen2 HDIV scores were first ranked among all HDIV scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank the score over the total number of the scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores, only the most damaging (largest) rankscore is presented. The scores range from 0.03061 to 0.91137.

name: Polyphen2_HDIV_pred
description: Polyphen2 prediction based on HumDiv, "D" ("probably damaging", HDIV score in [0.957,1] or rankscore in [0.55859,0.91137]), "P" ("possibly damaging", HDIV score in [0.454,0.956] or rankscore in [0.37043,0.55681]) and "B" ("benign", HDIV score in [0,0.452] or rankscore in [0.03061,0.36974]). Score cutoff for binary classification is 0.5 for HDIV score or 0.38028 for rankscore, i.e. the prediction is "neutral" if the HDIV score is smaller than 0.5 (rankscore is smaller than 0.38028), and "deleterious" if the HDIV score is larger than 0.5 (rankscore is larger than 0.38028). Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Uniprot_acc.

name: Polyphen2_HVAR_score
description: Polyphen2 score based on HumVar, i.e. hvar_prob. The score ranges from 0 to 1. Multiple entries separated by ";", corresponding to Uniprot_acc.

name: Polyphen2_HVAR_rankscore
description: Polyphen2 HVAR scores were first ranked among all HVAR scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank the score over the total number of the scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores, only the most damaging (largest) rankscore is presented. The scores range from 0.01493 to 0.97581.

name: Polyphen2_HVAR_pred
description: Polyphen2 prediction based on HumVar, "D" ("probably damaging", HVAR score in [0.909,1] or rankscore in [0.65694,0.97581]), "P" ("possibly damaging", HVAR in [0.447,0.908] or rankscore in [0.47121,0.65622]) and "B" ("benign", HVAR score in [0,0.446] or rankscore in [0.01493,0.47076]). Score cutoff for binary classification is 0.5 for HVAR score or 0.48762 for rankscore, i.e. the prediction is "neutral" if the HVAR score is smaller than 0.5 (rankscore is smaller than 0.48762), and "deleterious" if the HVAR score is larger than 0.5 (rankscore is larger than 0.48762). Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Uniprot_acc.

name: MutationTaster_score
description: MutationTaster p-value (MTori), ranges from 0 to 1. Multiple scores are separated by ";". Information on corresponding transcript(s) can be found by querying http://www.mutationtaster.org/ChrPos.html

name: MutationTaster_rankscore
description: The MTori scores were ranked among all MTori scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores of a SNV, only the largest MTori was used in ranking. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MTori scores in dbNSFP.

name: MutationTaster_pred
description: MutationTaster prediction, "A" ("disease_causing_automatic"), "D" ("disease_causing"), "N" ("polymorphism") or "P" ("polymorphism_automatic"). The score cutoff between "D" and "N" is 0.5 for MTnew and 0.31733 for the rankscore.

name: MutationTaster_model
description: MutationTaster prediction models.

name: MutationTaster_trees_benign
description: the number of decision trees of the Random Forest suggesting benign; trees_deleterious/(trees_benign+trees_deleterious) can be used as a measure for deleteriousness.

name: MutationTaster_trees_deleterious
description: the number of decision trees of the Random Forest suggesting deleterious; trees_deleterious/(trees_benign+trees_deleterious) can be used as a measure for deleteriousness.

name: MutationAssessor_score
description: MutationAssessor functional impact combined score (MAori). The score ranges from -5.17 to 6.49 in dbNSFP. Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Uniprot_entry.

name: MutationAssessor_rankscore
description: MAori scores were ranked among all MAori scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MAori scores in dbNSFP. The scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MutationAssessor_pred
description: MutationAssessor's functional impact of a variant - predicted functional, i.e. high ("H") or medium ("M"), or predicted non-functional, i.e. low ("L") or neutral ("N"). The MAori score cutoffs between "H" and "M", "M" and "L", and "L" and "N", are 3.5, 1.935 and 0.8, respectively. The rankscore cutoffs between "H" and "M", "M" and "L", and "L" and "N", are 0.9307, 0.52043 and 0.19675, respectively.

name: PROVEAN_score
description: PROVEAN score (PROVEANori). Scores range from -14 to 14. The smaller the score the more likely the SNP has damaging effect. Multiple scores separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_proteinid.

name: PROVEAN_converted_rankscore
description: PROVEANori were first converted to PROVEANnew=1-(PROVEANori+14)/28, then ranked among all PROVEANnew scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank the PROVEANnew score over the total number of PROVEANnew scores in dbNSFP. If there are multiple scores, only the most damaging (largest) rankscore is presented. The scores range from 0 to 1.

name: PROVEAN_pred
description: If PROVEANori <= -2.5 (rankscore>=0.54382) the corresponding nsSNV is predicted as "D(amaging)"; otherwise it is predicted as "N(eutral)". Multiple predictions separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_proteinid.

name: VEST4_score
description: VEST 4.0 score. Score ranges from 0 to 1. The larger the score the more likely the mutation may cause functional change. Multiple scores separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid. Please note this score is free for non-commercial use. For more details please refer to http://wiki.chasmsoftware.org/index.php/SoftwareLicense. Commercial users should contact the Johns Hopkins Technology Transfer office.

name: VEST4_rankscore
description: VEST4 scores were ranked among all VEST4 scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of VEST4 scores in dbNSFP. In case there are multiple scores for the same variant, the largest score (most damaging) is presented. The scores range from 0 to 1. Please note VEST score is free for non-commercial use. For more details please refer to http://wiki.chasmsoftware.org/index.php/SoftwareLicense. Commercial users should contact the Johns Hopkins Technology Transfer office.

name: MetaSVM_score
description: Our support vector machine (SVM) based ensemble prediction score, which incorporated 10 scores (SIFT, PolyPhen-2 HDIV, PolyPhen-2 HVAR, GERP++, MutationTaster, Mutation Assessor, FATHMM, LRT, SiPhy, PhyloP) and the maximum frequency observed in the 1000 genomes populations. Larger value means the SNV is more likely to be damaging. Scores range from -2 to 3 in dbNSFP.

name: MetaSVM_rankscore
description: MetaSVM scores were ranked among all MetaSVM scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MetaSVM scores in dbNSFP. The scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MetaSVM_pred
description: Prediction of our SVM based ensemble prediction score,"T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0. The rankscore cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.82257.

name: MetaLR_score
description: Our logistic regression (LR) based ensemble prediction score, which incorporated 10 scores (SIFT, PolyPhen-2 HDIV, PolyPhen-2 HVAR, GERP++, MutationTaster, Mutation Assessor, FATHMM, LRT, SiPhy, PhyloP) and the maximum frequency observed in the 1000 genomes populations. Larger value means the SNV is more likely to be damaging. Scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MetaLR_rankscore
description: MetaLR scores were ranked among all MetaLR scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MetaLR scores in dbNSFP. The scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MetaLR_pred
description: Prediction of our MetaLR based ensemble prediction score,"T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.5. The rankscore cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.81101.

name: Reliability_index
description: Number of observed component scores (except the maximum frequency in the 1000 genomes populations) for MetaSVM and MetaLR. Ranges from 1 to 10. As MetaSVM and MetaLR scores are calculated based on imputed data, the less missing component scores, the higher the reliability of the scores and predictions.

name: MetaRNN_score
description: Our recurrent neural network (RNN) based ensemble prediction score, which incorporated 16 scores (SIFT, Polyphen2_HDIV, Polyphen2_HVAR, MutationAssessor, PROVEAN, VEST4, M-CAP, REVEL, MutPred, MVP, PrimateAI, DEOGEN2, CADD, fathmm-XF, Eigen and GenoCanyon), 8 conservation scores (GERP, phyloP100way_vertebrate, phyloP30way_mammalian, phyloP17way_primate, phastCons100way_vertebrate, phastCons30way_mammalian, phastCons17way_primate and SiPhy), and allele frequency information from the 1000 Genomes Project (1000GP), ExAC, and gnomAD. Larger value means the SNV is more likely to be damaging. Scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MetaRNN_rankscore
description: MetaRNN scores were ranked among all MetaRNN scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MetaRNN scores in dbNSFP. The scores range from 0 to 1.

name: MetaRNN_pred
description: Prediction of our MetaRNN based ensemble prediction score,"T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.5. The rankscore cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.6149.

name: M-CAP_score
description: M-CAP is hybrid ensemble score (details in DOI: 10.1038/ng.3703). Scores range from 0 to 1. The larger the score the more likely the SNP has damaging effect.

name: M-CAP_rankscore
description: M-CAP scores were ranked among all M-CAP scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of M-CAP scores in dbNSFP.

name: M-CAP_pred
description: Prediction of M-CAP score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.025.

name: REVEL_score
description: REVEL is an ensemble score based on 13 individual scores for predicting the pathogenicity of missense variants. Scores range from 0 to 1. The larger the score the more likely the SNP has a damaging effect. "REVEL scores are freely available for non-commercial use. For other uses, please contact Weiva Sieh" (weiva.sieh@mssm.edu) Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid.

name: REVEL_rankscore
description: REVEL scores were ranked among all REVEL scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of REVEL scores in dbNSFP.

name: MutPred2_score
description: General MutPred2 score. Scores range from 0 to 1. The larger the score the more likely the SNP has a damaging effect.

name: MutPred2_rankscore
description: MutPred2 scores were ranked among all MutPred2 scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MutPred2 scores in dbNSFP.

name: MutPred2_pred
description: Prediction of MutPred2 score after calibration (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2022.10.013): PS (Strong Evidence of Pathogenic, score>=0.932), PM (Moderate Evidence of Pathogenic (Moderate evidence of pathogenicity, score >=0.829 and < 0.932), PP (Supporting Evidence of Pathogenic, score >=0.737 and <0.829), UC (Uncertain, score >0.391 and <0.737), BP (Supporting Evidence of Benign, score >0.197 and <=0.391), BM (Moderate Evidence of Benign, score >0.010 and <=0.197), BS (Strong Evidence of Benign, score <=0.010). Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid.

name: MutPred2_top5_mechanisms
description: Top 5 molecular mechanisms as predicted by MutPred2 with p values. The Pr is the "posterior probability of the loss/gain of certain structural and functional properties due to the substitution". The P is the "empirical P-value calculated as the fraction of benign substitutions in MutPred2's training set with Pr values >= to the Pr value for the given substitution." More details can be found at http://mutpred.mutdb.org/help.html.

name: MVP_score
description: A pathogenicity prediction score for missense variants using deep learning approach. The range of MVP score is from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The authors suggest thresholds of 0.7 and 0.75 for separating damaging vs tolerant variants in constrained genes (ExAC pLI >=0.5) and non-constrained genes (ExAC pLI<0.5), respectively. Details see doi: http://dx.doi.org/10.1101/259390 Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid.

name: MVP_rankscore
description: MVP scores were ranked among all MVP scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MVP scores in dbNSFP.

name: gMVP_score
description: A pathogenicity prediction score for missense variants using a graph attention neural network model. The range of gMVP score is from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-022-00561-w Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid.

name: gMVP_rankscore
description: gMVP scores were ranked among all gMVP scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of gMVP scores in dbNSFP.

name: MisFit_D_score
description: A pathogenicity prediction score for missense variants as to protein function. The range of MisFit_D score score is from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Recommended threshold for "pathogenicity" in disease genes is 0.45 (lenient) to 0.55 (stringent). Details see doi: 10.1038/s41467-025-59937-2.

name: MisFit_D_rankscore
description: MisFit_D scores were ranked among all MisFit_D scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MisFit_D scores in dbNSFP.

name: MisFit_D_pred_lenient
description: Prediction of MisFit_D score use a lenient threshold based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.45.

name: MisFit_D_pred_stringent
description: Prediction of MisFit_D score use a stringent threshold based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.55.

name: MisFit_S_score
description: An estimated selection coefficient of negative selection, range from 0 to 0.5. The scores below 1e-4 is considered as noise. The authors do not recommend a fixed threshold for pathogenicity. The optimal threshold depends on genes and age of onset of the condition. Per the authors' comments, "for early onset conditions such as neurodevelopmental disorders, S >= 0.1 is a good place to start for *diagnosis*, and S >= 0.01 is ok for gene discovery."

name: MisFit_S_rankscore
description: MisFit_S scores were ranked among all MisFit_S scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MisFit_S scores in dbNSFP.

name: MPC_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction score for missense variants based on regional missense constraint. The range of MPC score is 0 to 5. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: http://dx.doi.org/10.1101/148353. Multiple entries are separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_transcriptid.

name: MPC_rankscore
description: MPC scores were ranked among all MPC scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of MPC scores in dbNSFP.

name: PrimateAI_score
description: A pathogenicity prediction score for missense variants based on common variants of non-human primate species using a deep neural network. The range of PrimateAI score is 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The authors suggest a threshold of 0.803 for separating damaging vs tolerant variants. Details see https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-018-0167-z

name: PrimateAI_rankscore
description: PrimateAI scores were ranked among all PrimateAI scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of PrimateAI scores in dbNSFP.

name: PrimateAI_pred
description: Prediction of PrimateAI score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.803.

name: DEOGEN2_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction score "which incorporates heterogeneous information about the molecular effects of the variants, the domains involved, the relevance of the gene and the interactions in which it participates". It ranges from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is deleterious. The authors suggest a threshold of 0.5 for separating damaging vs tolerant variants.

name: DEOGEN2_rankscore
description: DEOGEN2 scores were ranked among all DEOGEN2 scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of DEOGEN2 scores in dbNSFP.

name: DEOGEN2_pred
description: Prediction of DEOGEN2 score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.5.

name: BayesDel_addAF_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction meta-score for SNVs and indels with inclusion of MaxAF. See https://doi.org/10.1002/humu.23158 for details. The range of the score in dbNSFP is from -1.11707 to 0.750927. The higher the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The author suggested cutoff between deleterious ("D") and tolerated ("T") is 0.0692655.

name: BayesDel_addAF_rankscore
description: BayesDel_addAF scores were ranked among all BayesDel_addAF scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of BayesDel_addAF scores in dbNSFP.

name: BayesDel_addAF_pred
description: Prediction of BayesDel_addAF score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.0692655.

name: BayesDel_noAF_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction meta-score for SNVs and indels without inclusion of MaxAF. See https://doi.org/10.1002/humu.23158 for details. The range of the score in dbNSFP is from -1.31914 to 0.840878. The higher the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The author suggested cutoff between deleterious ("D") and tolerated ("T") is -0.0570105.

name: BayesDel_noAF_rankscore
description: BayesDel_noAF scores were ranked among all BayesDel_noAF scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of BayesDel_noAF scores in dbNSFP.

name: BayesDel_noAF_pred
description: Prediction of BayesDel_noAF score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is -0.0570105.

name: ClinPred_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction meta-score for nonsynonymous SNVs. See https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2018.08.005. for details. The range of the score in dbNSFP is from 0 to 1. The higher the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The author suggested cutoff between deleterious ("D") and tolerated ("T") is 0.5.

name: ClinPred_rankscore
description: ClinPred scores were ranked among all ClinPred scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of ClinPred scores in dbNSFP.

name: ClinPred_pred
description: Prediction of ClinPred score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.5.

name: LIST-S2_score
description: A deleteriousness prediction score for nonsynonymous SNVs. See https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaa288. for details. The range of the score in dbNSFP is from 0 to 1. The higher the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. The author suggested cutoff between deleterious ("D") and tolerated ("T") is 0.85.

name: LIST-S2_rankscore
description: LIST-S2 scores were ranked among all LIST-S2 scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of LIST-S2 scores in dbNSFP.

name: LIST-S2_pred
description: Prediction of LIST-S2 score based on the authors' recommendation, "T(olerated)" or "D(amaging)". The score cutoff between "D" and "T" is 0.85.

name: VARITY_R_score
description: VARITY_R scores are pathogenicity prediction scores for rare human missense variants. The range of VARITY_R score is from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2021.08.012

name: VARITY_R_rankscore
description: VARITY_R scores were ranked among all VARITY_R scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of VARITY_R scores in dbNSFP.

name: VARITY_ER_score
description: VARITY_ER scores are pathogenicity prediction scores for extremely rare human missense variants. The range of VARITY_ER score is from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2021.08.012

name: VARITY_ER_rankscore
description: VARITY_ER scores were ranked among all VARITY_ER scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of VARITY_ER scores in dbNSFP.

name: VARITY_R_LOO_score
description: Same as VARITY_R except the prediction on the variants used for training was made using Leave-One-Variant out. Details see doi: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2021.08.012

name: VARITY_R_LOO_rankscore
description: VARITY_R_LOO scores were ranked among all VARITY_R_LOO scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of VARITY_R_LOO scores in dbNSFP.

name: VARITY_ER_LOO_score
description: Same as VARITY_ER except the prediction on the variants used for training was made using Leave-One-Variant out. Details see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2021.08.012

name: VARITY_ER_LOO_rankscore

name: ESM1b_score
description: ESM1b scores are log-likelihood ratio (LLR) scores for predicting the pathogenic effects of coding variants based on a 650-million-parameter protein language model, ESM1b. The range of ESM1b score in dbNSFP is from -24.538 to 6.937. The smaller the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-023-01465-0

name: ESM1b_converted_rankscore
description: ESM1b scores were firstly negated (i.e., -ESM1b_score), then ranked among all -ESM1b_score scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the -ESM1b_score over the total number of scores in dbNSFP.

name: ESM1b_pred
description: The authors do not recommend a threshold for separating deleterious (D) variants versus tolerated (T) variants. This prediction is based on the threshold of -7.5 described in their paper that yields a true-positive rate of 81% and a true-negative rate of 82% in their ClinVar and HGMD test datasets.

name: AlphaMissense_score
description: AlphaMissense is an unsupervised model for predicting the pathogenicity of human missense variants by incorporating the structural context of an AlphaFold-derived system. The AlphaMissense score ranges from 0 to 1. The larger the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adg7492. name: AlphaMissense_pred
description: The AlphaMissense classification of likely (B)enign, (A)mbiguous, or likely (P)athogenic with 90% expected precision estimated from ClinVar for likely benign and likely pathogenic classes.

name: PHACTboost_score
description: PHACTboost is a gradient boosting tree based classifier that combines PHACT scores with information from multiple sequence alignment, phylogenetic trees, and ancestral reconstruction. The range of the score is from 0 to 1, the larger the score the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see https://doi.org/10.1093/molbev/msae136. The authors recommend to use 0.62 as the cutoff for binary prediction (personal communication).

name: PHACTboost_rankscore
description: PHACTboost scores were ranked among all PHACTboost scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the PHACTboost_score over the total number of scores in dbNSFP.

name: MutFormer_score
description: MutFormer is an application of the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) NLP (Natural Language Processing) model with an added adaptive vocabulary to protein context, for the purpose of predicting the effect of missense mutations on protein function. The range of the score is from 0 to 1, the larger the score the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xinn.2023.100487. The authors recommend to use 0.8838 as the cutoff for binary prediction (personal communication).

name: MutFormer_rankscore
description: MutFormer scores were ranked among all MutFormer scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the MutFormer_score over the total number of scores in dbNSFP.

name: MutScore_score
description: MutScore is an ensemble score which integrate multiple unsupervised scores for DNA substitutions with additional positional clustering information. The range of the score is from 0 to 1, the larger the score the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2022.01.006. The authors recommend to use 0.5 as the cutoff for binary prediction (personal communication).

name: MutScore_rankscore
description: MutScore scores were ranked among all MutScore scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the MutScore_score over the total number of scores in dbNSFP.

name: popEVE_score
description: popEVE score "is a computational model for the prediction of variant severity and pathogenicity. It combines variation across species and variation within the human population for scores comparable across the whole proteome while minimizing population biases". The range of ESM1b score in dbNSFP is from -9.638 to 10.378. The smaller the score, the more likely the variant is pathogenic. Details see doi: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02400-1

name: popEVE_pred
description: This prediction is based on the thresholds described in the paper: popEVE_score < -5.056 is considered as (S)everely pathogenic; -5.056 <= popEVE_score < -4.617 is considered as (M)oderately pathogenic; popEVE_score > = -4.617 is considered as (B)enign.

name: popEVE_converted_rankscore
description: popEVE scores were firstly negated (i.e., -popEVE_score), then ranked among all -popEVE_score scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the -popEVE_score over the total number of scores in dbNSFP.

name: Aloft_prob_Recessive

name: Aloft_prob_Dominant

name: Aloft_pred

name: Aloft_Confidence
description: Confidence level of Aloft_pred; values can be "High Confidence" (p < 0.05) or "Low Confidence" (p > 0.05) multiple values separated by ";", corresponding to Ensembl_proteinid.

description: CADD raw score for functional prediction of a SNP. Please refer to Kircher et al. (2014) Nature Genetics 46(3):310-5 for details. name: CADD_phred

The larger the score the more likely the SNP has damaging effect. Please note the following copyright statement for CADD: "CADD scores (http://cadd.gs.washington.edu/) are Copyright 2013 University of Washington and Hudson-Alpha Institute for Biotechnology (all rights reserved) but are freely available for all academic, non-commercial applications. For commercial licensing information contact Jennifer McCullar (mccullaj@uw.edu)."

name: DANN_score
description: DANN is a functional prediction score retrained based on the training data of CADD using deep neural network. Scores range from 0 to 1. A larger number indicate a higher probability to be damaging. More information of this score can be found in doi: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btu703.

name: DANN_rankscore
description: DANN scores were ranked among all DANN scores in dbNSFP. The rankscore is the ratio of the rank of the score over the total number of DANN scores in dbNSFP.

name: fathmm-XF_coding_score
description: fathmm-XF p-values. Scores range from 0 to 1. SNVs with scores >0.5 are predicted to be deleterious, and those <0.5 are predicted to be neutral or benign. Scores close to 0 or 1 are with the highest-confidence. Coding scores are trained using 10 groups of features. More details of the score can be found in doi: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btx536.

name: fathmm-XF_coding_rankscore

name: Eigen-PC-raw_coding

name: Eigen-PC-raw_coding_rankscore
